video_title: Philadelphia 76ers Practice Media Availability 🎙️ | Kentavious Caldwell-Pope | 10.12.26

quotes.speaker: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope
quotes.summary_phrase: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope on Tyrese Maxey as a teammate
quotes.excerpt: He's a great teammate. He listens, he comes, he tries to explain a lot.
quotes.quote: As a teammate, I can say he's a great teammate. He listens, he comes, he tries to explain a lot. I've been asking him a lot of questions about the city, what's going on in his gym, and he's been great just by explaining and being that vet and that leader over here. In the summertime, he's him. He likes to compete, and I love that about Tyrese Maxey. He's going to compete every second, even if we're practicing or we're just training. He loves to compete, and I love that about him.
quotes.social_post: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope is impressed by Tyrese Maxey's work ethic and competitive nature in practice, calling him a workaholic who is always ready to compete.

quotes.speaker: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope
quotes.summary_phrase: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope on Tyrese Maxey's work ethic
quotes.excerpt: His work ethic is great. He's been listening and applying everything to the court that he sees.
quotes.quote: His work ethic is great. I'm on the second team with him, and we play a lot together, and he's been a great listener. He's been listening and applying everything to the court that he sees in film, or that I see, or any vet that's talking to him. He applies it to his game. As you can see, he's a workaholic. He's working now, getting his shots up, but I love the young guy and he just loves to compete.
quotes.social_post: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope says Tyrese Maxey is a great listener who quickly applies feedback from veterans to his game.

quotes.speaker: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope
quotes.summary_phrase: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope's advice to young players
quotes.excerpt: Just be patient, keep working hard, keep showing up in practice, whenever your number is called, be ready.
quotes.quote: What I've always been telling all the young guys: just be patient, keep working hard, keep showing up in practice, whenever your number is called, be ready. That's pretty much all I can give them.
quotes.social_post: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope shares his simple advice for young players: be patient, keep working hard, and be ready when your number is called.

quotes.speaker: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope
quotes.summary_phrase: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope on playing with stars
quotes.excerpt: There's a lot of wide open shots out there, especially when you're playing with LeBron, Joel and Maxey.
quotes.quote: Being ready to shoot. There's a lot of wide open shots out there, especially when you're playing with LeBron, Joel and Maxey. It's going to be a lot of wide open shots. Just be ready to shoot, and I'm always just going to do what I do best: play defense and shoot the ball. My game is pretty much accommodate anybody's games, so I'm just looking forward to being out there with these guys.
quotes.social_post: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope knows his role on the 76ers is clear: play defense and be ready to knock down wide open shots created by LeBron, Joel Embiid, and Tyrese Maxey.

quotes.speaker: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope
quotes.summary_phrase: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope on LeBron James' leadership
quotes.excerpt: I think his impact is just his presence, his leadership and just being here, speaking.
quotes.quote: I think his impact is just his presence, his leadership and just being here, speaking. When he sees things on the floor, I think he's still trying to learn everything as far as what to say on the court, what's the calls and stuff like that. Once he learns that, I think everything's going to be great. Right now, he's still trying to figure it out.
quotes.social_post: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope says LeBron James is still adjusting to the team's specific calls and terminology but is already providing a major impact through his presence and leadership.

quotes.speaker: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope
quotes.summary_phrase: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope on his connection with Joel Embiid
quotes.excerpt: Being from Georgia and being on the same team, I can see his work ethic.
quotes.quote: It's been great. We talked about this on the way back from Boston, just being from Georgia and being on the same team. I played against Joel for a while now, and just being on this team, I can see his work ethic. When he comes to work, he's focused, and he's just ready to get out there.
quotes.social_post: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope says he has been impressed by Joel Embiid's focus and work ethic since joining the 76ers.

quotes.speaker: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope
quotes.excerpt: I think just our chemistry is going to be the biggest part for us.
quotes.quote: I think just our chemistry is going to be the biggest part for us, being able to like each other, being able to come to work, and being able to be around each other, have fun on and off the court. I think that's going to be our biggest thing because we have so much talent from one through 12 or 15. There's talent everywhere, so I think our biggest thing is just communicating with each other, learning each other's tendencies and trying to implement that on and off the court.
quotes.social_post: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope believes team chemistry will be the deciding factor for the 76ers this season, noting that the roster has talent from top to bottom.

quotes.speaker: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope
quotes.excerpt: Definitely our rebounding, we got our rebounding in the three games we played so far.
quotes.quote: Definitely our rebounding, we got our rebounding in the three games we played so far, and I think that's the main thing, rebounding and then taking care of the ball. We have a lot of turnovers, or the other team forced a lot of turnovers, and we had a lot of careless ones ourselves. But I think rebounding and taking care of the ball is going to be our biggest emphasis.
quotes.social_post: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope identifies rebounding and taking care of the ball as the two main areas the 76ers must improve after a high number of turnovers in early games.
